components.name: Metric
components.description:
Figma Primitives/Metric/Metric-Inline/Icon-Highlight (595:55188): Dock-Icon + Contents (gap 2XSmall) of
Label (Neutral/Light) over the Metric-Number (Neutral/Strongest), then the trend.

props.name: label
props.description: Figma Metric-Title.

props.name: value
props.description: Figma Metric-Number — pass it already formatted ("$1,680.68").

props.name: trend
props.description: Figma Trend: { direction, label } → Metric-Trend badge.

props.name: icon
props.description: Figma Dock-Icon: Neutral Subtle (Large at XLarge/Large, Medium below). `false` hides it.

props.name: iconTheme
props.description: Dock-Icon Theme — colour-code the metric's category (Figma instance swap). Default Neutral.

props.name: iconBackground
props.description: Dock-Icon Background: Subtle (default) or Solid for the one metric that should lead.

props.name: iconEmoji
props.description: Dock-Icon Theme=Emoji: an emoji instead of an icon (e.g. team mood).

props.name: size
props.description: Figma Size: XLarge/Large stack the icon above the text; Medium–XSmall put it on the left. Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Figma Metric-Inline type. Icon-Highlight (default, 595:55188): the Dock-Icon leads, the label sits over the number.
Title-Highlight (7523:507049): the title on top (Heading/Subheading at XLarge–Medium, Caption above the number at
Small/XSmall), the number and trend under it, the Dock-Icon pinned to the bottom-right corner.

props.name: action
props.description: Title-Highlight, XLarge–Medium: the title row's action (Figma Button/Icon-Main XSmall Tertiary, e.g. a chevron that opens the breakdown).

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Dock-Icon size (Figma instance swap): Medium 40 or Large 56. Default: Large at XLarge/Large, Medium below.

props.name: custom
props.description:
Title-Highlight: Figma Custom-Slot (Custom=Yes, added 2026-10-07): your own content under the contents — a sparkline,
a ProgressBar, a breakdown — Spacing/Gap/Medium below at XLarge/Large, Spacing/Gap/Small at Medium–XSmall. The
Dock-Icon stays at the contents' bottom-right corner.

props.name: metricColor
props.description:
Figma Metric-Color: a dot before the label (Element-Size/Popular/XSmall, Corner-Radius/Rounded) that ties the
 metric to a chart series. `true` is Color/Background/Accent/Solid; a string is the series colour
 (`var(--zen-color-background-support-blue-solid)`).

props.name: counter
props.description:
Icon-Highlight: Figma Counter — a Small Neutral Subtle Badge after the label, Spacing/Gap/2XSmall from it (a count
 of what the metric covers, e.g. "3" open invoices).

props.name: labelIcon
props.description: Title-Highlight, XLarge–Medium: Figma Label-Icon — a 24px icon (Element-Size/Popular/Medium) before the title.

props.name: hint
props.description:
Title-Highlight, XLarge–Medium: Figma Hint — an info icon after the title (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) that shows
 this text in a Tooltip on hover and focus; say how the number is worked out.
